subject: SecurOps: prioritize BYOK & retention requests from LumenHealth
messages:
From: Olga Petrov <olga.petrov@redwood.com>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>, Rafael Mendes <rafael_mendes@redwood.com>, Claire Bishop <claire@lumenhealth.com>
Cc: security@lumenhealth.com
Date: 2026-08-02T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: SecurOps: prioritize BYOK & retention requests from LumenHealth

Hi team — copying in Claire from LumenHealth. They sent a short security request list tied to an upcoming procurement milestone and want a clear plan and owners. Key asks (high level):

- BYOK/KMS integration (per-tenant keys, ability to rotate and revoke)
- Per-tenant audit log export with retention controls (7 year retention requirement called out)
- SSO + SCIM provisioning and IdP push for role sync
- Evidence for SOC2 artifacts and an NDA amendment for the extended retention ask

Attachments: retention_matrix.xlsx (customer retention matrix), byok_flow.png (requested key flow).

Immediate ask: can each of you call out blockers, rough ETA for an MVP (not full hardened solution) and whether the hosted API path or Dedicated/private path is required to meet the control? Claire, feel free to add anything I missed.

Goal: give Claire a prioritized plan and a target date for a technical spike by end-of-week.

Thanks —
Olga
Olga Petrov
Head of Security Partnerships | Redwood Inference
olga.petrov@redwood.com
From: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
To: Olga Petrov <olga.petrov@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>, Rafael Mendes <rafael_mendes@redwood.com>, Claire Bishop <claire@lumenhealth.com>
Date: 2026-08-02T11:01:00-07:00
Subject: Re: SecurOps: prioritize BYOK & retention requests from LumenHealth

Thanks Olga — quick technical readout from infra/runtime:

1) BYOK/KMS
- Dedicated: straightforward path. We can integrate customer-managed KMS (AWS KMS CMKs or a vault + HSM) and wire key material to the serving cluster. Estimated spike: 2 weeks to prove end-to-end for one model / tenant.
- Hosted: harder. For hosted API we'd need either a per-tenant HSM-backed key ring (complex ops + cost) or an envelope key flow where customer key material never touches our HSMs. That path requires legal + product acceptance; estimate 6–10 weeks for an MVP.

2) Audit logs / retention
- We can produce per-tenant audit streams. The retention policy is primarily a storage/retention-layer change + export tooling. For a 7-year retention SLA we need a tiered storage plan and a migration strategy for historical data — this is mostly infra work but needs product gating. Spike: 1 week to build schema + export proof; 3–4 weeks for an MVP retention config on Dedicated.

3) SSO/SCIM
- SCIM + SAML/OIDC is supported in principle. We will need to add role mapping for tenant boundaries. Spike: 1 week.

Blockers: KMS/HSM procurement for hosted, regulatory review for 7-year retention, and a decision on whether we allow customer-side key rotation APIs. Attaching initial SSO Q&A (sso_qna.pdf) for Claire.

I recommend: prioritize retention config + audit export first (lower operational risk), run a BYOK spike concurrently targeting Dedicated, and then decide hosted constraints after security review.

—Karthik
Karthik Iyer
Principal Infrastructure Engineer | Redwood Inference
From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
To: Olga Petrov <olga.petrov@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>, Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>, Rafael Mendes <rafael_mendes@redwood.com>, Claire Bishop <claire@lumenhealth.com>
Date: 2026-08-02T13:45:00-07:00
Subject: Re: SecurOps: prioritize BYOK & retention requests from LumenHealth

Good summary. A few product notes:

- Prioritization: I agree with Karthik — retention + audit exports are high impact and lower risk; we can deliver something that satisfies procurement quickly.
- UX: We need a simple tenant-level toggle for retention and a self-serve export button; add a note for RBAC around audit access.
- Pricing / SLAs: If we support 7-year retention it will affect storage costs — need finance input for a pricing addendum.

Can someone from legal confirm whether an NDA amendment or data-processing addendum is required before we expose additional logs? Laura? Rafael — please weigh in on procurement timing so we can align product sprints.

Action: I'll draft a product epic around retention + export (SEC-988) and add acceptance criteria for export format and retention enforcement.

Thanks —
Marissa Cole
Senior Product Manager, Platform | Redwood Inference
From: Claire Bishop <claire@lumenhealth.com>
To: Olga Petrov <olga.petrov@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>, Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>, Rafael Mendes <rafael_mendes@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-08-02T16:02:00-07:00
Subject: Re: SecurOps: prioritize BYOK & retention requests from LumenHealth

Thanks all — this is helpful. A couple of clarifications from LumenHealth side:

- Procurement: we have a hard procurement windows the week of 2026-09-20 and need commitments for technical feasibility by 2026-08-13.
- NDA/SLA: we can route an NDA amendment through procurement but would prefer to have a proposal from Redwood for retention pricing/terms before legal engages.
- Evidence: if you can provide SOC2 artifact pointers and a short note on the export format (CSV/NDJSON), that will help our security team.

Can we schedule a 30-minute call next week (Aug 9–11) to review the spike plan and draft acceptance criteria? Michael Chen (procurement) is looped for timing.

Claire Bishop
Head of Security & Compliance | LumenHealth
